body:
P2-25 DESIGN for N-34 (design PR #96, helper-n34): what to call, and what to wait for. Information, not a command: the lead and the advisor decide.

1. THE SKIP RULE is textnorm.survives_fold_whole(text), defined once in textnorm.py (era 0 until P2-25 slice 2: after NFKD every letter and digit that is not a combining mark is ASCII; era 1 after: true for any text with a letter or digit). It is the rule your step 0 already describes, and the shared equivalent the advisor asked for: the first PR that needs it (your slice 1 or P2-25 slice 1) defines it with the fixture rows (docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md, P2-25 part 4), the second imports it; refile carries its own TEST ROW, not its own copy of the rule. Call it on the lead artist, the title and, when you compare it, the album. NOT "the key is empty": fairuz|habibi| (a Latin artist with two different Arabic titles that start with Latin) and |habibi| (two artists with one Latin title) are not empty and are wrong.
2. THE ROWS your tests need (the same table as P2-25 slice 1): fully non-Latin; MIXED SCRIPT (Latin artist + Arabic, Cyrillic or Japanese title and the reverse); EXTENDED LATIN (Polish l-stroke, Turkish dotless i, German sharp s, Icelandic eth and thorn, Scandinavian o-slash and ae: these FAIL era 0; the a-ring, the stacked Vietnamese marks, s-cedilla, g-breve and the dotted capital I PASS).
3. REFILE MUST ALSO REFUSE A REF ON THE P2-25 WORKLIST (refs.recheck_pending, from P2-25 slice 3): such a ref may hold files that belong to other songs until the rehome of slice 4 has judged them. A moved file is a new music-server id: your slice 5 and the rehome do not clash (the rehome moves a database row and touches no music file; refile moves a music file and registers its new id).
4. WHAT P2-25 CHANGES FOR YOU: the order (P2-25 is placed before N-34 by your PR; mine does not touch order.json or your item), the skip guards (marked STOP-GAP(P2-25 skip-rule), removed one release after P2-25 slice 3), and B-133 (the cover finder gets the same rule).
